profile.headline: Software Developer at OpenPath Products
profile.summary: JP Kim has been a part of the OpenPath Products team since October of 2020. Specializing in Android App Development, David JP Kim strives everyday to expand and improve his software development skill set to be an asset to whatever company he is a part of.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Software Development specializing in Android App Development and Java.

positions.title: Delivery Driver
positions.description: Made and delivered made to order pizzas in a time efficient and satisfactory manner.

positions.title: Python Developer
positions.description: Worked on a team of three lead by a professor to develop a convolutional neural network that analyzed and categorized different motions from video clips. The dataset used to train the neural network was UCF-101.

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description: Advised students during the entirety of their college experience to ensure they were in compliance with college rules, resolved disputes between housemates and roommates, and built a welcoming community for a variety of different people.

positions.title: Customer Associate
positions.description: Handled several customer transactions on a daily basis while providing superb customer service,

volunteerExperiences.description: In addition to the required volunteer work by all brothers, the High Rho is responsible for keeping in contact with any and all alumni from Lambda Chi at McDaniel College.
